prompt_template: What is {a} × {b}? Answer with only a number.
chat_template: model tokenizer chat template, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False
target: decimal digits of a*b+1 followed by the end-of-turn token; prompt tokens have loss weight 0
model_selection_rule: highest mean ORDINARY-product accuracy of the unmodified model across the 5 eval groups; ties (within 1 point) go to the smaller model. No +1 result is used for selection.

budget_guard.note: assumed rates are deliberately pessimistic upper bounds, not published prices
